correctness.rationale: PASS: For each n≥3 with nonempty A,B, strictly positive normalized fractions π and positive class row rates a,b, the detailed-balance similarity makes M self-adjoint in weighted L2(π). Its class-constant Rayleigh compression equals H(t)=diag(a,b)−t vv^T, v=(P^{-1/2},−Q^{-1/2}), where reciprocal cross flux 0≤t≤min(Pa,Qb). The largest eigenvalue L(t) decreases strictly for a≠b by equality characterization of the rank-one Loewner perturbation. Every matrix therefore has ρ(M)≥L(t*). The explicit bipartite-positive, within-class-diagonal M* obeys row sums, weighted reciprocity, is irreducible, and has an everywhere positive lifted quotient eigenvector realizing L(t*). Equality of the global and compressed Rayleigh maxima forces the lifted eigenvector to be an M eigenvector; x≠y implies all cross-class row totals constant at t*/P and t*/Q; conversely these totals give an everywhere positive Perron eigenvector. For a=b, constant row sums force ρ=a. Independent rational four-type witness and numerical symmetric eigenvalue checks support finite instances, not infinity.
